name: speakers_search
title: Search remembered people
description: Searches people by name, alias, slug, or project presentation name, resolving similar names before the user is asked to choose.

include_other_projects.description: With project_id, include other people in that studio only when the caller owns it. Shared-project access remains project-scoped.

project_id.description: Optional project public ID to limit results.

limit.description: Maximum matches to return. Default 10, maximum 25.
